goals: Verify that login with valid credentials produces a valid JWT, login with invalid credentials produces an invalid JWT, and user custom data can be updated and retrieved
Verify that logout invalidates the JWT, that user rights return a vector of 1 right, and that token refresh invalidates the previous JWT and issues a valid new one
activities: Start Kuzzle Server; create user 'my-user-id' with credentials 'my-user-name'/'my-user-pwd'
Log in as 'my-user-name':'my-user-pwd'; verify JWT is valid
Log in as 'my-user-name-w':'my-user-pwd'; verify JWT is invalid
Log in as 'my-user-name':'my-user-pwd-w'; verify JWT is invalid
Log in as 'my-user-name-w':'my-user-pwd-w'; verify JWT is invalid
Log in as 'my-user-name':'my-user-pwd'; update user custom data with 'my_data':'mystringvalue'
Retrieve user info; verify response 'content' field contains 'my_data':'mystringvalue'
Log in; verify JWT is valid; log out; verify JWT is invalid
Log in; retrieve user rights; verify rights vector contains exactly 1 right
Log in; verify JWT is valid; refresh JWT; verify previous JWT is invalid; verify new JWT is valid
